title: Authorization documents
description: Consent and authorization templates. The clinic logo is added to the PDF when signed.
empty_hint: Create one here. Then, from the patient history, the consultation menu lets you send it to the owner.
cuerpo_hint: Bold, center and lists to shape the document. For the date line use ciudad, dia, mes_nombre and anio (or fecha_corta).
delete_description: «{{nombre}}» will be deleted. Already signed documents are kept.
